about_the_game:
🏆 In The Press

"Humanity Echo’s simple look lets you focus on what’s important: thoughtful, grid-based firefights... where stray bullets can impact the field."

— Turn Based Lovers

🏙️ A Dirty War for the Future

Odesa, 2044. Corporations play god while the streets drown in chaos. Your father’s disappearance drags you into a war of extermination involving the Resistance, the fanatical Order, and the Prospect corporation. There is no "right" side. Only choices, consequences, and the price you’ll pay.

You’re not a soldier, but an Engineer. Don’t play by the rules – set them: lay traps, deploy gadgets, and force enemies to walk exactly where they’ll lose.

🔫 Unforgiving Tactics

In Humanity Echo, consequences matter as much as accuracy.

  • Stray Bullets: A miss doesn’t vanish – it keeps going. It shatters cover, ignites fuel behind enemy lines, or strikes an ally. Mind your fire vector.

  • Arsenal and Choice: Ammo is the new currency. Standard rounds are plentiful, but premium munitions cost a fortune. Choose when to save and when to spend it all on one decisive shot.

  • Positioning: Frontal assaults are risky. Use blind spots and crossfire to deny the enemy any chance to retaliate.

🧬 The Engineer's Approach

No class restrictions. Your fighter is a system you design yourself. Limits come only from equipment slots and your remaining humanity.

  • Gadgets Decide: Turrets, drones, mines. Victory is forged before the first shot.

  • Cybernetics: Implants change the rules. Tactical optics enable sniper fire; reinforced actuators turn a fighter into a mobile battering ram. But power comes at the cost of your sense of self.

  • Preparation: Don’t just shoot – set traps. Lure enemies into chokepoints where turret crossfire awaits.

⚔️ Game Modes

  • Narrative Campaign: A non-linear story where choices define your allies and enemies.

  • PvP Duels (Coming Soon): Hotseat and Remote Play Together modes arriving in upcoming updates. Sharpen your skills in the campaign – living opponents won’t forgive mistakes.

🎮 Demo Available Now

Experience the core gameplay today:

  • Story prologue and introduction to Odesa 2044.

  • Full tactical combat with ballistics physics.

  • First steps in customizing your squad.

📥 Download the DEMO to test your tactics.

💾 Add to Wishlist to not miss the PvP update and full release!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (2015 or newer) / Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 2–compatible GPU, 2 GB VRAM (Intel Iris 2015+ or Apple GPU), MoltenVK/Vulkan
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (M2 or newer) / Intel Core i5 (2019 or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU or Radeon Pro 2018+, 4 GB VRAM, Metal 2
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Odesa, 2044. Your father's disappearance pulls you into a corporate war. You are an Engineer - an architect of the battlefield. Lead your squad in this gritty turn-based tactical RPG: deploy gadgets, integrate combat implants, and master destructible terrain. Hack the system before it deletes you.
supported_languages: English, Ukrainian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese
